# Vault release cadence

@include 'alerts/enterprise-only.mdx'

Vault Enterprise and HCP Vault Dedicated follow a regular release cadence.

## Vault versioning

@include 'version-syntax.mdx'

## Feature release windows

Vault plans four feature release windows each year:

Quarter | Target month | Release type
------- | ------------ | ------------
Q1      | February     | Minor
Q2      | May          | Major
Q3      | August       | Minor
Q4      | November     | Minor

These release windows are targets, not guaranteed release dates. Always check
the current [release notes](/vault/docs/updates/release-notes) for available
releases.

## Feature and fix availability

Vault introduces features in major and minor releases and does not backport
features across releases. 

For example:

- The 2.x release in April 2026 was a **major** release, with documented release
  dates for the release candidate (RC) and general availability (GA) binaries
  noted in the release notes. Major releases remain eligible for minor releases
  for 1 year and patch releases for an additional 2 years.

- The subsequent releases of 2.1.0 and 2.2.0 were **minor** releases that included
  feature updates. 

- The other releases were **patch / fix** releases that included bug fixes and
  critical security patches.
  
To receive bug fixes and keep patches current, you need to upgrade to the
latest patch release of the associated major release, which includes any new
features introduced in subsequent minor releases.

If you want to receive bug fixes and security patches without feature updates,
you should wait to upgrade until we publish the final minor release for a given
major release.

Even if you have technical support, resolving an issue may require upgrading to
a version that includes the necessary fix.

## Final minor releases

The **final minor release** is the last minor release published before the next 
major release becomes available. After the next major becomes available, we
continue to apply eligible fixes to the previous major release for one year (the
second year of SC2 base support), but do not include new features.

For additional information about support coverage, refer to the
[Vault Enterprise support](/vault/docs/enterprise/support) overview.

## Patch availability

Patch releases target a monthly cadence, but not every eligible major receives
a patch each month. Check the release notes for shipped fixes and consult
security advisories or IBM Support for issue-specific guidance.

## Upgrade planning

Upgrade to the latest version of your major release to receive subsequent fixes.
You do not need to adopt the latest major release solely to retain fix coverage,
but you cannot receive new features packaged in the latest major release without
upgrading. 

If you plan feature upgrades once a year, we recommend targeting the final
minor of a major and keeping its patches current. For example, if you upgrade to
the last minor version of 2.x when it enters its second year of base support,
you gain access to the feature updates released in 2.x, with another year of
eligible patches.
